# dsh-plugin-ade (`@community/dsh-plugin-ade`)
> Hyprland-style drag-to-split multi-pane conversation layout for DeepSeek Harness Desktop.
## Overview
`dsh-plugin-ade` transforms the DeepSeek Harness conversation area into a binary-tree multi-pane wor
kspace without unmounting or losing live session state:
- **Edge-Drop Splitting** — Drag any session from the sidebar onto the **left / right** edge for a h

orizontal split, or **top / bottom** edge for a vertical split, with live drop-zone previews.
- **Dr
ag-to-Reorder & Swap** — Drag any pane header onto another pane's center to swap positions, or onto

any edge to re-split with live visual indicators.
- **Scoped Split Orientation Toggle** — Toggle hor
izontal (`⇄`) and vertical (`⇅`) split orientation per immediate split pair without resetting siblin

g panes.
- **Flat Positioned Layout Engine** — Panes render as flat sibling nodes (`computeTreeGeome

try`) so splitting, reordering, or resizing never unmounts active React trees or composer inputs.
-
**Glassmorphism & Motion Lab Compatible** — Preserves full backdrop-filter sampling across composers

and slash command menus.
- **Saved Layout Presets & Persistence** — Pin named multi-pane layouts in
a new **Layouts** sidebar section above Workspaces. Tap one-click presets (**Side by Side**, **Stac
ked**, **Master + Stack**, **Quad Grid**), save the current split under a custom name, or delete sav
ed layouts. The active tree auto-restores on restart. Auto-split Subagents can be switched ON/OFF he

re too.
- **Live Agent Status Pills** — Each pane header shows a real-time **RUNNING** timer while t
he session is executing and an attention pulse for pending input, plus a **READY** completion pill w

hen a reply is waiting.
- **Subagent Stack Pane** — Subagents no longer explode your workspace into
`N` panes. The first child splits the parent once; every later child joins the same right-hand pane
as a swipeable chip strip. The pane auto-follows the running child, clicks swap instantly without re
mounting, chips can pop into dedicated panes (up to 4 total), and completed children stay until dism

issed.
- **Lineage Graph & Layout Scoping (NEW)** — Unreal Blueprint-style visual session and subage
nt graph canvas. Opening the graph from an active split or saved layout isolates nodes strictly to t
he layout's panes and their transitive subagents (`Layout Only`), with instant filtering across save

d layout groups and `All`.
- **Sidebar Subagent Hierarchy (NEW)** — Parent sessions in the sidebar d

isplay a toggle chevron to expand and inspect child subagent sessions inline.
- **DSH Cookie Mainten
ance Scripts** — Includes `npm run check-cookies` and `npm run clean-cookies` to prevent DSH ephemer
al port header overflow (`HTTP 431` "Web authentication failed").

## Usage
1. **Create a Split**: Drag a session row from the left sidebar over the conversation view. Hover ne

ar the **left**, **right**, **top**, or **bottom** edge to preview the split zone, then drop.
2. **R

esize Panes**: Drag the divider handle between any two split panes.
3. **Toggle Split Axis**: Click
the `⇄` / `⇅` button in a pane header to flip that pane's immediate split between horizontal and ver

tical.
4. **Reorder / Swap Panes**: Drag a pane by its header bar into the center of another pane to

swap, or onto an edge to re-dock.
5. **Close a Pane**: Click `✕` in the pane header to close the sp
lit slot and return the remaining tree space.
